currentParagraphText: “I gotta ask... aren’t you needed to do stuff here on Earth? With the World Council and all that?” Jake asked as he looked at the old man.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “I gotta ask... aren’t you needed to do stuff here on Earth? With the World Council and all that?” Jake asked as he looked at the old man.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “No, and if I am, this is a good opportunity for those who rely on me to figure out solutions on their own,” the Sword Saint answered bluntly. Jake had noticed the old man seemed a bit on edge both now and during the meeting earlier, and he had a theory as to why.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “He’s joking. For a Chosen to charge paltry amounts to assist his fellow natives of the universe would be unsightly,” he said, Jake not sure if the old man was trying to save Jake’s dignity or just really wanted to move things along.
